# PAYSAVE OS — Physical Schema Specification v1.0

> **Stage:** 3.1 — Physical Schema Specification  
> **Status:** APPROVED — Physical Schema Review accepted by Decision Owner on 2026-07-21  
> **Role:** Principal Database Engineer  
> **Upstream authority:** Engineering Blueprint v1.0 / Architecture Freeze v1.0 / Logical Database Design v2.1 / ERD v2.1  
> **Scope:** PostgreSQL physical schema specification only  
> **Stage 3.1 boundary:** This document remains a non-executable specification; executable SQL is owned by Stage 3.2 migrations.  
> **Review state:** ACCEPTED by Decision Owner; not self-approved

## 0. Scope and interpretation

This specification expands all 161 frozen logical tables into approved physical column contracts. It does not itself create database objects, migration artifacts, API endpoints, handlers, runtime policies or deployment. All “default” values below are descriptive physical decisions implemented only by the separately reviewed Stage 3.2 migrations.

Each table contains: Physical Column, PostgreSQL Data Type, Nullability, Default Value, Constraint, FK, Index, RLS Requirement, Encryption, Retention and Archive Strategy. RLS/Retention/Archive are table-level contracts; column-level encryption and FK/index participation are explicit in each row.

### Canonical counts

| Metric                              | Expected |
| ----------------------------------- | -------: |
| Frozen domains                      |       21 |
| Frozen logical/physical tables      |      161 |
| Frozen ERD relationship obligations |      217 |
| Frozen event contracts              |      114 |

### Global physical rules

- Identity: UUID entity IDs; UUIDv7 generation is a Physical Schema Review decision and must never be recycled.
- Tenant isolation: tenant-owned tables require non-null `partner_id`, same-tenant FK enforcement and fail-closed RLS. Mixed global/tenant tables use nullable approved scope only, separate uniqueness domains and no sentinel UUID.
- Defaults: business status, money, classification, permission, consent, legal basis and approval result have no implicit default. Generated identity, UTC record time and initial positive version are the only proposed technical defaults.
- Delete behavior: RESTRICT by default. Business history is never cascade-deleted. Soft-retirable current-state tables use retirement columns; append-only tables use retention/archive instead.
- Encryption: plaintext direct identifiers, contact values, precise location and protected narrative are prohibited where the column contract specifies ciphertext. Exact sensitive lookup uses keyed digest only.
- Legal hold: legal hold, dispute, investigation and regulatory preservation override every disposition clock.
- Optional FK nullability follows frozen ERD cardinality. Typed alternatives and approval/evidence links require table-level one-of or state predicates so a valid lifecycle state cannot bypass required integrity.
- Lifecycle timestamps remain null before their transition; the corresponding status transition requires the timestamp, enforces chronology and prevents contradictory early values.
- Index notation is non-executable: `PK candidate`, `UQ` and `IX` specify exact ordered column candidates for Review; names, opclasses, predicates and deployment remain blocked pending benchmark evidence and acceptance.

## 1. Per-table Physical Schema Specifications

### T001 `tenant.partners`

**Purpose:** Tenant root  
**Profiles:** Constraint `C01`; Index `I01`; Partition `P00`; Encryption `E00`; Classification `C3/P2`  
**Table constraints:** C01: code unique; soft delete; soft retirement only; active uniqueness excludes deleted rows  
**FK policy:** Every typed FK below uses `RESTRICT`; tenant parents use same-tenant composite enforcement.  
**Index contract:** PK candidate `[id]`; UQ business key `[code]`  
**RLS Requirement:** REQUIRED tenant-root RLS: row `id` must match an active authorized membership `partner_id`; global administration uses a separately audited authority and write checks fail closed.  
**Retention:** `RT-01`; the longest applicable subject/legal class wins.  
**Archive Strategy:** Export eligible rows/object manifests, reconcile count/checksum, restore sample, then authorized disposition. version/identity snapshot export with checksum; verified anonymization/disposal after eligibility Legal hold, dispute, investigation and regulatory preservation always suspend deletion.

### T161 `event_catalog.compatibility_reviews`

**Purpose:** Contract compatibility decision  
**Profiles:** Constraint `C04`; Index `I04`; Partition `P00`; Encryption `E00`; Classification `C2/P1`  
**Table constraints:** C04: same definition; append-only; append-only; corrections are new facts; no update/delete semantic  
**FK policy:** Every typed FK below uses `RESTRICT`; tenant parents use same-tenant composite enforcement.  
**Index contract:** PK candidate `[id]`; IX FK `[event_version_id]`; IX FK `[previous_version_id]`; IX FK `[reviewed_by]`; IX FK `[approval_request_id]`; IX keyset `[event_version_id, reviewed_at DESC, id DESC]`  
**RLS Requirement:** Global/control-plane table: tenant-row RLS is not applicable; direct writes restricted to named global authority, tenant reads only through approved control-plane policy.  
**Retention:** `RT-09`; the longest applicable subject/legal class wins.  
**Archive Strategy:** Export eligible rows/object manifests, reconcile count/checksum, restore sample, then authorized disposition. versioned control-contract archive after supersession Legal hold, dispute, investigation and regulatory preservation always suspend deletion.
